task: Migrate Pine workflows from actions/checkout v4 on Node.js 20 to v6 on Node.js 24

subtasks.description: Freeze a permissively licensed historical dependency edge and its exact upstream repair
lessons: Closed issues can support objective historical migration replays, but cannot be presented as current contribution opportunities.

subtasks.description: Query AEG before execution and audit the below-threshold ranking
lessons: A generic GitHub Actions overlap scored only 0.0143, so AEG correctly withheld a migration capsule.

subtasks.description: Reproduce and repair the Node 20 action reference at the frozen parent commit
lessons: Enumerate every pinned action reference before changing a major version so a migration is complete rather than sample-based.

subtasks.description: Validate reference counts, YAML syntax, patch scope, and whitespace
lessons: Static workflow validation is a useful local oracle, but it does not replace a hosted GitHub Actions run.

constraints: Use only public MIT-licensed source and public issue metadata.
Do not push, comment, open a pull request, or trigger upstream workflows.
Limit the patch to three action references in two workflow files.
Do not claim hosted runner compatibility from local static checks.
lessons: Freeze the parent of the known migration commit to make a historical dependency replay deterministic.
Count old and new action references across the complete workflow set; a green YAML parse alone cannot detect an incomplete runtime migration.
AEG correctly abstained because its verified records contained CI process experience but no Node-runtime or action-major migration rule.
Separate local configuration proof from end-to-end hosted runner evidence and maintainer acceptance.
